title: Edible 솔로 #003 · hourglass bombshell · 빨강 녹은 사탕 · 팔짱 · 공연장 · 잉크 블랙립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, waist-length braids dark brown hair — full body melting swirled hard candy fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is real hard candy curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, thick glossy sugar syrup in red and white swirls slowly stretching and dripping down her body in long sticky strands and pooling in shining puddles around her feet, nothing lying flat. Dense surface — BLAZING candy-red and cream-white swirled stripes of glossy molten sugar across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID clear sugar-glass edges glinting along the swirls and tiny rainbow sprinkles caught in the sticky surface, with tiny sugar pearls pressed along the surface, high-gloss sticky, richly saturated in colour, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing tall, arms crossed under her bust, chin raised, looking down at the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same hard candy, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same hard candy with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, heavy gold rings on every finger, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT candy — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
